name: customer-service-skills
description: Skills for the Customer Service team. Holds upload-documents, which builds the workbook that attaches a folder of documents onto items that already exist in a Worldmaker app, reading each document to decide what kind of document it is, and extract-document-text, which converts those document files to Markdown under uv, renders the pages of scanned PDFs that hold no text, and reads those pages with OCR on request.
